instructions.measurementWindowStart: Exact ISO-8601 start of the real measurement window. Do not copy regression fixture dates.
instructions.measurementWindowEnd: Exact ISO-8601 end of the real measurement window.
instructions.reactionSnapshotRunsPerDay: Owner-approved positive integer cadence with evidence.
instructions.cadenceEvidenceRef: Non-secret evidence reference for the approved cadence.
instructions.measuredAt: Exact ISO-8601 timestamp when real quota usage measurements were completed.
instructions.uploadManifestPageCountPerReactionRun: Measured positive integer pages traversed across the selected audit cohort per reaction run.
instructions.videoCountPerReactionRun: Measured positive integer included-video count across the selected audit cohort per reaction run.
instructions.measuredUsageEvidenceRef: Non-secret evidence reference for measured page/video counts.
instructions.maxChannelIdsPerCall: Evidence-backed positive integer ID-filter batch limit. Do not infer from maxResults.
instructions.maxVideoIdsPerCall: Evidence-backed positive integer ID-filter batch limit. Do not infer from maxResults.
instructions.providerBatchLimitEvidenceRef: Non-secret provider evidence for both exact ID batch limits.
